mechanism_narrative: A GDP level above 10000 billion dollars (GDPC1 > 10000) signals a strong economy, which consistently leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p>0.05) when GDPC1 > 10000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% (UNRATE > 5.0%) indicates a deteriorating labor market, which typically results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p>0.05) when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 105 (INDPRO < 105) combined with a high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals an economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p>0.05) when INDPRO < 105 and UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) signals a monetary tightening cycle, which typically results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A retail sales level above 300000 million dollars (RSAFS > 300000) signals strong consumer demand, which consistently leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p>0.05) when RSAFS > 300000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (INDPRO < 100) signals an economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p>0.05) when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales below 380000 (RSAFS < 380000) combined with a decline in housing starts below 950 (HOUST < 950) signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p>0.05) when RSAFS < 380000 and HOUST < 950.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation (CPIAUCSL > 200) leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as it signals central bank tightening and reduced risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p>0.05) when CPIAUCSL > 200.
